title: Incident evidence package and customer consent choices — compact brief
summary: Compact guidance for customers on available consent options and the contents of an evidence package after the April 17 inference integrity incident. Designed to be short for account teams to paste into customer threads and to provide clear choices (opt-in replay, opt-out, request evidence-only, request partial redaction) plus a transparent timeline and verification checklist.
audience: Primary: affected customer technical and security contacts. Secondary: account managers and legal where replay or PII redaction requests may be escalated.
key_decisions: Customer consents to full replay of their tenant traffic: Redwood will deliver a time-bounded replay run and a signed verification report.
Customer requests evidence-only package (no replay): include sanitized request/response excerpts and system logs relevant to their tenant.
Customer requests selective redaction: Redwood will remove any identified PII before delivering materials; redaction can be automated or manual review depending on sensitivity.
Customer declines any data sharing: Redwood will record the choice and proceed with internal-only investigations and offer summary findings.
Default if no response in 14 days: deliver evidence-only package with aggressive PII minimization and offer additional follow-up upon customer request.
evidence_package_contents: high-level incident chronology specific to customer tenant (timestamps in UTC)
sanitized request/response excerpts (first 5 and last 5 of affected window) with token-level redaction markers
service-side telemetry: latency histograms, queue lengths, routing decisions for the tenant during the window
server process logs correlated by request-id (where available) with TTLs and cache events
model variant and container image hashes (to reproduce serving configuration)
signed SHA256 digest of the evidence bundle and chain-of-custody note
operator notes summarizing root-cause hypotheses and confidence levels
timeline: 2026-04-17 02:14 UTC: first anomaly detected by synthetic checks; 02:16 UTC: automated throttling kicked in; 02:25 UTC: on-call runbook invoked and teams paged; 02:40–03:10 UTC: degraded responses observed for ~8% of tenants; 03:30 UTC: service routing fallback applied; 06:00 UTC: full mitigation verified for core paths; 2026-04-17 12:00 UTC: initial statuspage update posted; follow-on verification and evidence collection completed by 2026-04-20.
customer_instructions: Reply to this thread with your choice (full-replay | evidence-only | redact-and-deliver | no-share).
If choosing full-replay, confirm a contact email and an availability window for a one-hour review call.
If requesting redaction, specify the sensitivity class (PII | PHI | proprietary) and any known tokens/phrases to prioritize.
To receive only an audit summary, request 'evidence-only' and optionally list up to 3 example request-ids for prioritized extraction.
If no reply within 14 days, we will send the evidence-only package with PII minimized.
verification_steps: Redwood packages artifacts and runs automated PII-scan (48–72 hours).
Customer receives package and a signed bundle digest for integrity verification.
Optional: customer requests replay; Redwood schedules replay on an isolated staging cluster and provides a signed transcript of the run.
Customer and Redwood jointly confirm evidence items on a verification call; discrepancies are tracked in JIRA linked in the bundle.
Final closure note with a short remediation summary posted to statuspage and attached to the evidence package.
operator_notes: Prioritize tenants that explicitly request full-replay; get legal signoff if replay includes PII even if sanitized.
When preparing sanitized excerpts, preserve token alignment markers so customers can map redactions back to original positions.
Use the 'evidence-builder-v2' script on infra nodes tagged 'evidence-collector' to assemble bundle and compute SHA256.
Escalate any urgent redaction requests to security-compliance@redwood.com within 4 hours of receipt.
Mark the bundle with the internal handling label 'cust-evidence:high-sensitivity' if manual review occurred.
sample_statuspage_text: We experienced a regional inference-response integrity incident affecting a small percentage of requests between 02:14–03:10 UTC on 2026-04-17. Mitigation was applied and full service restored by 06:00 UTC. Affected customers will be offered an evidence package and optional replay. For details and to request specific remediation steps, contact your account team or reply to this communication.
follow_up_actions: Customer-success to send personalized email within 24 hours with the choices and a one-click response template.
Evidence team to produce first tranche of packages within 3 business days after consent received.
SRE to attach final remediation summary to the public postmortem within 7 days.
Legal to review any replay consent forms where PII is suspected before replay is scheduled.
